# GR01-handshake-session: The probe on Test (vendor.grok.protocol, "ACP authRequired on Test"): initialize, then session/new in Dim Factory's own probe folder, no prompt, no token. The answer advertises loadSession and session/resume, the sign-in methods Grok can use (its cached sign-in first) and its version in _meta; session/new names the models (unstable models and a configOptions model select) and no modes (Grok has no ACP mode switch). The launch probe stops at initialize.
# --cwd is an empty scratch folder (the probe runs in Dim Factory's own tmp/probe-cwd); a signed-in profile.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.grok.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor grok --grok-home "<fixture GROK_HOME>" --bin "<the grok executable>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/grok/acp/GR01-handshake-session --id GR01 --slug handshake-session --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR01-handshake-session/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR01-handshake-session/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR01-handshake-session/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- agent --no-leader stdio
